## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：按 W3-C1R（#28545，`eeec88d1`）留下的 20 条清单准确性发现，逐条对照当前 main 源码复核后改了平台测试清单：9 个区文件、13 个条目，每个条目 revision +1 并追加一行 history。19 条落地修改；第 16 条（Studio 发布提示文字）main 上已由 #28526 改好，记为「已在上游修好」，不重复改。
- 为什么改：这些步骤里的计数、错误码、路由和入口已经过时（例如 Setup 现有 50 个入口、设置命名空间有 11 个、成员打开 Setup 设置页现在显示「无权访问」而不是嵌在别的应用里），每轮 P0 冒烟都要多走一遍手工核对或报出假问题。不改，#27377 发版巡检锚点无法收口。
- 风险与回滚：只改 QA 清单 JSON，不动产品代码、不进任何发布包；没有任何判据被放宽，只补得更准或更严。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json`（`builtin-apps-nav-render` 的 negative[3] 改写与 `nav-surfaces-render` 的常设手工项）；`approvals.json` 的 `account-app-entry` acceptance[0]（接受调度方构建，但新增「服务端入口包与 dist 一致」核对）；`integration-system.json` 的 knownGaps[5]（两条新凭据通道）。
- 两分钟验证：仓库根运行 `pnpm check:platform-checklist`，预期最后一行以 `check-platform-checklist: OK — 16 areas, 352 items` 开头。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Twenty checklist-accuracy findings that QA run #28545 (W3-C1R, at `eeec88d1`) parked on anchor comment 6554042054 were each re-verified against source at `6b9c1ca991` before editing. 19 rows are edited across 13 items in the nine area files the card names. One row (16) had already landed upstream. Every edited item gets `revision` +1 and one `history` row citing #28545 and #28641. Main's history stays an exact prefix. No file outside the nine is touched. No clause is weakened.

## Tests

Docs only: no package source changes, so no build closure and no package test suite is owed (os-dev local-verification scope ①/②). `skip-changeset`: the diff touches only `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json`, which no package ships.

## Acceptance notes

- Row 12 offers two remedies. Adding a Reports entry to SURFACES edits `examples/app-showcase/e2e/showcase-smoke.spec.ts`, which is outside this card's file surface. So the item names `/reports` as the standing hand-walk, and the SURFACES entry is left to the seat as an out-of-scope note.
- Row 17: the Records grid's add-column header also carries "Add field" (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`). The step names the Form tab, where #28545 found it, and mentions the grid header too.
- Row 19 describes only what `datasource-env-credential.ts`, `common.zod.ts`, `datasource.zod.ts` and ADR-0015 D7 already state. It adds no repro detail.
